tunables.description: Location of Go workspace and downloaded modules.

tunables.label: Go Cache
tunables.description: Build cache directory for Go compiler outputs.

tunables.description: Toggles CGO binding for statically linked pure Go binaries.
tunables.troubleshooting: Set to 0 for pure static Go binaries without glibc/musl dependencies.
